message: Setsugekka and Arakawa Sonomi walked together into "Rairaiken," a diner in a corner of the shopping area.

name: Iori
message: 「...Sigh, I'm starving.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Indeed.」
It was around 11 o'clock when Setsugekka bumped into Arakawa Sonomi at the convenience store, hit it off with her for whatever reason, and went into the diner.
And so, for about an hour already, I've been staking out the place with Asahi from a spot where we can see the diner's entrance.

name: Iori
message: 「Hey, Asahi, how long do you plan on keeping watch here？」

name: Asahi
message: 「Let's keep at it right into the middle of the night today.」

name: Iori
message: 「Wha—？！ Until the middle of the night？！」

name: Asahi
message: 「From her earlier conversation with that Arakawa Sonomi person, we obtained some very valuable information regarding Setsugekka-san.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Therefore, we will stick it out a little longer.」

name: Iori
message: 「No, no, even so...」

name: Asahi
message: 「Iori-sensei, when it comes to a stakeout, patience comes first, and patience comes second.」

name: Asahi
message: 「We don't have the help of surveillance cameras outside the academy, so we have no choice but to do the legwork.」

name: Iori
message: 「If it's cameras you want... look, there's one right there.」
Looking up, several security cameras were mounted on the utility poles.

name: Asahi
message: 「Sensei, the cameras here are outside Murakumo Academy's jurisdiction.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Accessing cameras managed by the municipal government is difficult, and if the hacking is discovered, the police will get involved.」

name: Asahi
message: 「We wouldn't be able to cover it up if an accident occurred.」

name: Asahi
message: 「In that respect, the academy hates turning things into police matters. That leaves plenty of room for intervention.」

name: Iori
message: 「C-Cunning, or whatever you'd call it... you're something else, Asahi.」

name: Asahi
message: 「I'll take that as a compliment♪」
Just as we were talking about that.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Aaah, that was delicious~！」
Setsugekka and Arakawa Sonomi came out of the diner.

name: Sonomi
message: 「This place is my regular haunt. The old guy running it gives it real character, don't you think?」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Totally！ The tables were grimy, the menus were old, and that retro vibe that made you go 'So this is the Showa era~' was the best！」

name: Sonomi
message: 「You don't know a damn thing about the Showa era.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Well, my grandmother was about my age right now, after all.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Anyway, I want to try making a rice dish next time!」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I just love fried rice, you know~」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Yeah, sure, if there’s another chance.」
They are chatting harmoniously. It seems they’ve gotten quite close.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Anyway, Master, thanks a million for teaching me all this today！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I really agreed with you that a villain’s intimidation starts with their way of speaking.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「From now on, I want to actively use heel-speak, so please keep guiding me！」

name: Sonomi
message: 「O-oh, yeah, just do your best.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Also, after listening to you, Sono-chan-senpai, I found so many things I can use！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「So, I’m going to make a note of them as the 'Sono-chan Anthology'.」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Hey, knock it off with the 'anthology' thing！ It’s embarrassing！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「But you had so many great lines？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Like, ‘What the hell are you glaring at, punk?！’ or」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「‘Don’t you go tryin’ to bluff me, you bastard！’ or something like that.」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Did I ever say stuff like that？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I thought the best one was your word of encouragement~」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「‘What’s the matter, gettin’ rusty? Go in there and smash ’em up~！’」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yeah, it’s good… it’s seriously so cool.」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Nah, that’s not encouragement, that’s just baiting them.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Eh? But if you translate it, doesn’t it mean ‘Your true power isn’t just this, keep working harder’?」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Doesn’t that sound super supportive？」

name: Sonomi
message: 「W-well, if that’s how you’re gonna interpret it, I guess that’s fine.」

name: Sonomi
message: 「And quit translating it. It’s kinda killing the vibe.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Anyway, that makes me one of the villains now!」

name: Sonomi
message: 「‘One of them,’ you say? When you do it, it just looks like <d0045>Bimiyan</d> acting all tough, you know……」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「What’s a Bimiyan? Is it a friend of <d0046>Bamiyan</d>?」

name: Sonomi
message: 「It’s totally different, you don’t need to know.」
And just like that, I locked eyes with Arakawa Sonomi.

name: Iori
message: 「Damn, I’ve been spotted……！」

name: Sonomi
message: 「Tch…… I thought I felt someone watching me, but it’s just the Teach.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「The Teach？ Wait, aaaah！ Mr. Muragaki！？」

name: Sonomi
message: 「I’m taking off, catch ya later.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hey, Master！？」
No sooner had she said that than Arakawa Sonomi slipped around the street corner and vanished.

name: Asahi
message: 「It can’t be helped. Let’s at least secure Setsugekka-san.」
Asahi moved ahead and blocked Setsugekka’s path.

name: Asahi
message: 「Please wait, Setsugekka-san.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ugh…… you’re Kuki Asahi-chan, right？」

name: Asahi
message: 「Yes, that’s right.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「W-why are you with Mr. Muragaki！？」

name: Asahi
message: 「To enjoy some one-on-one time with Iori-sensei, of course.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Eh, does that mean…… that naughty teacher-student stuff？」

name: Asahi
message: 「Yes, that naughty stuff♪」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Whoa……」

name: Iori
message: 「No, that’s completely wrong！？ And Asahi, quit saying such random things！」

name: Asahi
message: 「Sensei, I’m pretty sure we were doing something naughty.」

name: Iori
message: 「Well, I mean, yeah, but……！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Oh, really?」

name: Iori
message: 「No, that’s not it! What I was doing was stalking and hacking! I wasn’t doing anything like illicit dating!」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Aww, what a letdown.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「...Wait, stalking？ Don’t tell me you were tailing me！？」
Ah, damn it.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「That’s awful! Is a teacher even allowed to do something like that!？」

name: Iori
message: 「I’m sorry. I knew it was wrong to do, but...」

name: Asahi
message: 「Teacher, Iori-sensei.」
Asahi pulls on me and whispers furtively.

name: Asahi
message: 「Now is not the time to apologize. Let’s stay firm.」

name: Iori
message: 「B-but, you know...」

name: Asahi
message: 「*Sigh*... Iori-sensei, you’re too soft.」

name: Asahi
message: 「It can’t be helped. I’ll show you how it’s done this time.」
Asahi spins around to face Setsugekka.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「What are you two whispering about in secret? That’s rude.」

name: Asahi
message: 「My apologies for making you jealous.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Jealous, shmealous♪」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「...Like I’d be jealous！」

name: Asahi
message: 「By the way, Setsugekka-san, what brings you to a place like this？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「What do you mean, ‘what brings me’? I just came here for lunch like a normal person.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Heh, is that so?」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「What’s with that attitude? What are you trying to say?」

name: Asahi
message: 「I heard that you were absent today due to poor health, Setsugekka-san.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Yet, here you are, going out normally, coming all the way to a shopping mall, and having a pleasant meal with Arakawa Sonomi-san.」

name: Asahi
message: 「You look remarkably energetic for someone in poor health, don’t you？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ah, I was feeling under the weather this morning, but I recovered around noon！ So I came here to grab something to eat！」

name: Asahi
message: 「You left the dorm at 9:45, headed for the convenience store, and made contact with Arakawa Sonomi behind the store at 10:00.」

name: Asahi
message: 「You traveled while chatting, and arrived at the shopping mall shortly after 11:00. You then had a meal at the set-meal restaurant there for about an hour.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「A-ahhhhhhh…………！！！」

name: Asahi
message: 「So, what was that again？ What was it that recovered around noon？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「How！？ How do you know all that！？」

name: Asahi
message: 「I told you I was tailing you. Your every move has been accounted for.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Whoa~！ You’re a spy, there’s a <d0047>James Mondo</d> right here~~！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「D-damn it, but I won’t lose to you.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「For times like these, I’ve got the Sono-chan lexicon！」
Setsugekka activates her HR and starts checking something.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「...Oi, oi, don’t you go lookin' down on me！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I don't wanna see your ugly mug, you hear?！ Better scram before I knock you out with one punch, bastard！」

name: Iori
message: 「I don't find that kind of foul language very impressive, Setsugekka.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Psh, as if I’d ever listen to some teach! I’m gonna come <d0075>pay you a visit</d>, yeah!？」
I don’t know what to do; even when Setsugekka tries to intimidate me, I’m not scared at all. Must be because she’s just too cute.

name: Asahi
message: 「Setsugekka-san, Setsugekka-san.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「What do you want, you teacher’s pet?！ I’ll mess you up, you idiot！」

name: Asahi
message: 「I’m recording this right now. Would you mind if I showed this to your sister later？」

name: Setsugekka
message: <s32>「Pffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffft！？」</s>

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Wait, cut！ Can we please cut all of that right now！！」
Setsugekka flails and struggles, trying to snatch the camera from Asahi’s hands.

name: Iori
message: 「Folded like a lawn chair.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Setsugekka-san, that kind of language toward Iori-sensei, our assistant homeroom teacher, is unacceptable.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I'm sorry, I'm sorry, I take it back, I apologize, I'll get on my knees and beg」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「So please delete that video you just took！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Okay, take two！ Take two starts now！ Actio—！」

name: Asahi
message: 「Don't worry」

name: Asahi
message: 「I'll edit your heroic tales so they're super easy to watch and deliver them to Keisetsu in tip-top shape」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「That's the absolute worst director's cut in history？！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「W-What will it take for you to stop？」

name: Asahi
message: 「Promise me. That you'll attend classes properly starting tomorrow」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Huh, w-well, that's...」
She stole a glance at my face, only to blush and look down.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Uuuugh, b-but Mr. Muragaki's face is just so erotic」

name: Iori
message: 「W-What the heck is that supposed to mean...」

name: Asahi
message: 「Mr. Iori's face really is erotic, isn't it」

name: Iori
message: 「Could you not agree with such an obviously problematic statement？！」
"Erotic" is definitely not a compliment.

name: Asahi
message: 「Setsugekka, if you won't promise me, things are going to get very unpleasant for you」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「W-What are you planning to do？」

name: Asahi
message: 「I'll report to Kazamine Keisetsu that you skipped class today」

name: Asahi
message: 「Along with the video I just took of you as evidence」
Setsugekka clutched her head and crouched down.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Waaaah！ It's over, I'm totally done for！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I'm so gonna get yelled at！ Nooo, I don't want a lecture！！」
Just as she stood back up, she started spinning around in circles on the spot.

name: Iori
message: 「H-Hey, don't lose your head like that」
Drawn by the commotion, onlookers started gathering around, wondering what was going on.
And among those onlookers—

name: Ririmu
message: 「Ooh, did somethin' happen？ Did somethin' happen？」
Popping right out—a familiar face.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Wait, gyaaaah？！」

name: Iori
message: 「Ah, Ririmu！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Wh-wh-what's Iorin doing in a place like this？！」

name: Iori
message: 「What are *you* doing here?」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Th-that's my freedom to do whatever I want！」

name: Asahi
message: 「Students of this academy do not have the freedom to skip class and slack off.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Whoa, and even <d0048>Kijo</d> is here too！」

name: Asahi
message: 「Who are you calling Kijo?」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Guh, tactical retreat！」

name: Iori
message: 「Wait, Ririmu！」
Just as I'm about to give chase, I remember I'm still in the middle of dealing with Setsugekka.

name: Iori
message: 「Wait, huh? Where's Setsugekka?」
Setsugekka, who should have been right beside me, had vanished before I knew it.
...Or so I thought, when down the alley, the sight of Setsugekka bolting away.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I-I'll let you off easy today！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「You better watch out next time we meet！」
Leaving behind a parting threat, Setsugekka fled to the other side of the alley.

name: Asahi
message: 「Iori-sensei, let's split up.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Sensei, Ririmu-san. I'll go after Setsugekka-san.」

name: Iori
message: 「Alright, got it！！」
Exchanging a nod, Asahi and I broke into a run toward our respective targets.
